name: Salesforce
one_liner: Enterprise customer relationship management platform for sales pipeline, lead management, and customer lifecycle.
auth_methods: OAuth2, JWT Bearer Token, Connected App Credentials
access_details: Free Developer Edition orgs provide instant, lifetime access with full REST/SOAP/GraphQL API capabilities; production orgs require paid enterprise licenses.
api_surface: REST, GraphQL, SOAP, Bulk API 2.0, Streaming Webhooks (Pub/Sub)
main_blocker: None for Developer Orgs; SOQL query complexity and tenant permission sets require careful token scoping.
composio_strategy: Managed OAuth2 Connected App with composable SOQL execution and standard CRM CRUD action primitives.
verification_notes: Pass 1 noted paid tiers, but Pass 2 confirmed Free Developer Edition offers full API access without card.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: Inbound CRM, sales enablement, and marketing automation suite with deep contact timeline tracking.
access_details: Free developer accounts and sandbox portals can be created in <2 minutes; free tiers include Private App tokens.
api_surface: REST (v3 CRM Objects), Webhooks, Search API
main_blocker: None; daily burst rate limits (100 req/10s on free tiers) require backoff handling.
composio_strategy: Dual OAuth2 / Private App token toolkit supporting contacts, deals, tickets, and custom object mutations.
verification_notes: Private App tokens replaced legacy API keys in 2022; perfectly suited for zero-friction agent auth.

name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Sales-focused pipeline CRM designed for visual deal tracking and activity scheduling.
auth_methods: OAuth2, Personal API Token (Query Param / Bearer)
access_details: Free Sandbox account available via Developer Hub; standard 14-day trial provides immediate Personal API token in Settings.
main_blocker: None; rate limit is 80 requests per 2-second window for token-based calls.
composio_strategy: Standard OAuth2 app registration with token fallback for deals, stages, activities, and leads.
verification_notes: Developer sandbox permits OAuth2 app development without a paid subscription.

name: Attio
one_liner: Next-generation real-time relationship CRM built on a flexible data model and automatic data enrichment.
access_details: Free tier available; API keys can be generated instantly from Workspace Settings > Developers.
main_blocker: None; dynamic custom attributes require fetching object schemas before writing records.
composio_strategy: API Key / OAuth2 integration with schema-aware object assertion and record upserts.
verification_notes: Clean modern OpenAPI spec available, highly agent-friendly payload structures.

name: Twenty
one_liner: Modern open-source CRM alternative to Salesforce with custom object schemas and kanban boards.
auth_methods: Bearer API Key, JWT Access Token
access_details: 100% free and open-source self-hosting (Docker); hosted Twenty Cloud offers free tier with instant API key creation.
main_blocker: None; fast release cycle means API schemas update frequently.
composio_strategy: Deploy official MCP wrapper or REST/GraphQL action set supporting standard CRM primitives.
verification_notes: Pass 1 marked as purely REST; Pass 2 verified native GraphQL endpoint & official MCP support.

name: Podio
one_liner: Customizable workspace and work management CRM platform by Citrix for project collaboration and records.
access_details: Free tier (up to 5 employees); developer API keys can be requested immediately in account settings.
main_blocker: None; complex hierarchical data model (Organizations > Workspaces > Apps > Items).
composio_strategy: OAuth2 toolkit with helper actions to resolve app and workspace identifiers.
verification_notes: App authentication mode allows server-to-server operations without end-user re-authorization.

name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: Full-featured omnichannel CRM suite for lead management, sales automation, and analytics.
access_details: Free tier (up to 3 users); Zoho Developer Console allows immediate creation of Self-Client tokens for testing.
main_blocker: Data center partitioning (e.g. .com, .eu, .in) requires multi-region base URL routing.
composio_strategy: Multi-region OAuth2 provider handling automatic DC redirection for Leads, Accounts, and Deals.
verification_notes: Verified v6 API is current; Self-Client grant allows quick testing without spinning up an HTTP callback.

name: Close
one_liner: Inside-sales CRM built for high-velocity calling, SMS sequences, and automated pipeline workflows.
auth_methods: HTTP Basic (API Key as username), OAuth2
access_details: 14-day free trial gives full API access; API keys generated with a single click in Settings > API Keys.
main_blocker: None; pristine REST API with comprehensive activity timelines.
composio_strategy: API Key header auth wrapper for leads, contacts, opportunities, and automated task triggers.
verification_notes: Close uses standard HTTP Basic where API key is passed as username with empty password.

name: Copper
one_liner: Google Workspace-native CRM for managing customer relationships directly inside Gmail and Calendar.
auth_methods: API Key + User Email Headers, OAuth2
access_details: 14-day free trial requires business email; API keys generated in Settings > Integrations > API Keys.
main_blocker: Custom header requirement (`X-PW-AccessToken` and `X-PW-UserEmail`) must accompany every request.
composio_strategy: Composio custom auth provider injecting user email and token headers into REST calls.
verification_notes: Dual header auth is unusual; agent correctly flags required email header.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: Specialized deal and relationship management CRM designed for private equity, investment banking, and M&A.
access_details: Strictly enterprise contract gated via Intapp; no public sign-up or trial sandbox; API credentials provisioned per corporate tenant.
main_blocker: Partner/contract gate; requires active enterprise Intapp DealCloud contract and client admin configuration.
composio_strategy: Bring-Your-Own-Credentials (BYOC) enterprise connector targeting tenant-specific subdomains.
verification_notes: MAJOR CORRECTION: Pass 1 mistook Swagger docs for public self-serve access. In reality, access is strictly gated behind Intapp corporate contracts.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Enterprise customer service ticketing, knowledge base, and customer engagement ecosystem.
auth_methods: OAuth2, API Token (Basic Auth: email/token:token), Bearer Token
access_details: 14-day free trial gives immediate admin access to generate API tokens or register OAuth apps; Sponsor Developer Program provides free sandbox.
main_blocker: Subdomain routing (`{subdomain}.zendesk.com`) and granular role-based permissions.
composio_strategy: OAuth2 multi-tenant connector supporting ticket creation, search, internal notes, and status transitions.
verification_notes: Zendesk API is gold standard for customer support agents. Dual OAuth and API token support.

name: Intercom
one_liner: AI-first customer service platform featuring live chat messenger, automated bot resolution, and proactive support.
access_details: Free Developer Workspace can be created in Intercom Developer Hub without payment; 14-day free trial on production.
main_blocker: API version headers (`Intercom-Version: 2.11`) are required; conversation state locks when Fin bot handles it.
composio_strategy: OAuth2 connector enabling agent handoff, conversation replies, tag management, and contact sync.
verification_notes: Developer workspaces provide zero-cost sandboxes for building agent toolkits.

name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Cloud customer support software with omnichannel ticketing, SLA management, and team collaboration.
auth_methods: HTTP Basic (API Key as username), OAuth2
access_details: Free plan includes up to 10 agents with instant API key access in Profile Settings.
main_blocker: Subdomain routing (`{domain}.freshdesk.com`) and rate limits (50 calls/min on free plan).
composio_strategy: API Key wrapper providing ticket creation, agent assignment, and SLA tracking actions.
verification_notes: Free tier has real API access, making it very accessible for testing.

name: Front
one_liner: Customer communication hub combining shared team inboxes with CRM data and automated routing.
access_details: Free developer account can be requested on developer portal; standard 7-day trial provides immediate API token.
main_blocker: Message threading semantics and channel-specific drafting constraints.
composio_strategy: OAuth2 and API token connector for shared inbox queries, comment posting, and message sending.
verification_notes: Front's REST API is well-versioned with comprehensive webhook support for incoming message streams.

name: Pylon
one_liner: Modern B2B support platform built natively for Slack connect channels, in-app chat, and ticketing.
access_details: Targeted at B2B high-touch companies; requires sales demo or onboarding call to provision account; API key generated in workspace settings.
main_blocker: Commercial account setup requirement; no instant self-serve self-signup on homepage.
composio_strategy: BYOC API key integration supporting issue lifecycle, Slack channel mapping, and customer account sync.
verification_notes: Pass 1 assumed self-serve; verified that Pylon is an enterprise/B2B product requiring contact or invitation to provision.

name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Omnichannel helpdesk and real-time live chat platform with ticket management and call center tools.
access_details: 14-day free trial requires no credit card; API keys generated under Configuration > System > API.
main_blocker: None; comprehensive Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0 specification available.
composio_strategy: Direct API key connector mapped to tickets, chats, canned responses, and agent routing.
verification_notes: Well-documented REST v3 interface with downloadable OpenAPI definitions.

name: Plain
one_liner: Modern customer support platform purpose-built for engineering and technical B2B support teams.
access_details: Free tier available; self-serve sign up provides instant API key under Settings > API Keys.
main_blocker: GraphQL-first paradigm requires structured queries rather than simple REST endpoints.
composio_strategy: GraphQL agent skill exposing pre-parameterized mutations for customer threads, notes, and labels.
verification_notes: Pass 1 listed REST API; Pass 2 corrected: Plain's primary developer surface is purely GraphQL.

name: Help Scout
one_liner: Collaborative shared email helpdesk with customer history, knowledge base (Docs), and live chat (Beacon).
access_details: 15-day free trial gives full access to create OAuth2 App credentials in My Profile > Authentication.
main_blocker: OAuth token expiration (short-lived access tokens require automatic refresh token handling).
composio_strategy: OAuth2 Client Credentials & Auth Code toolkit for conversations, mailboxes, threads, and customers.
verification_notes: Clean Mailbox v2 REST API with predictable JSON-LD pagination.

name: Gorgias
one_liner: E-commerce-specialized help desk integrating Shopify, BigCommerce, and Magento order data into customer tickets.
access_details: 7-day free trial gives immediate admin dashboard access to generate API Key under Settings > REST API.
main_blocker: Domain-prefixed endpoints (`{domain}.gorgias.com/api/`).
composio_strategy: API Key / OAuth2 connector supporting ticket creation, customer order contextualization, and macro execution.
verification_notes: E-commerce order integration actions make Gorgias a high-value tool for shopping agents.

name: Gladly
one_liner: People-centered customer service platform treating customer interactions as a single lifetime conversation.
access_details: Enterprise sales gate; requires direct sales engagement and contracted enterprise onboarding to provision tenant.
main_blocker: Sales-gated onboarding; no public self-serve sandbox for independent developers.
composio_strategy: Enterprise BYOC connector requiring client domain and provisioned admin credentials.
verification_notes: Pass 1 assumed standard SaaS trial; Pass 2 verified Gladly requires scheduled sales demo with no free self-signup.

name: Slack
one_liner: Leading enterprise workplace communication and channel-based collaboration platform.
auth_methods: OAuth2, Bot User OAuth Token (`xoxb-`), User Token (`xoxp-`)
access_details: 100% free instant access; create free Slack workspace, create app at api.slack.com/apps, install to workspace in 60 seconds.
api_surface: Web API (REST), Events API (Webhooks), Socket Mode (WebSocket), Block Kit
main_blocker: None; granular OAuth scopes (`chat:write`, `channels:read`, etc.) must be defined upfront.
composio_strategy: Premier Composio integration supporting Socket Mode for bidirectional agent chat and Block Kit UI rendering.
verification_notes: Gold standard for agent communication. Socket Mode eliminates need for public webhook ingress.

name: Twilio
one_liner: Programmable communication platform for SMS, voice calls, WhatsApp, and telephony verification.
auth_methods: HTTP Basic (Account SID:Auth Token), API Key & Secret
access_details: Free trial provides instant sandbox credentials and $15+ testing credits with immediate phone number provisioning.
main_blocker: Trial numbers require verifying recipient phone numbers before sending SMS.
composio_strategy: Account SID + Auth Token action set for SMS dispatch, phone number lookup, and voice call dispatch.
verification_notes: Frictionless developer onboarding; instant test credentials.

name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Team chat and collaborative business messaging software with bots, widgets, and audio/video channels.
access_details: Free plan includes up to 100 users; developer console enables quick bot creation and token generation.
main_blocker: Multi-datacenter domain routing (`cliq.zoho.com`, `cliq.zoho.eu`).
composio_strategy: OAuth2 bot integration for channel messaging, direct message dispatch, and interactive cards.
verification_notes: Cliq bot tokens allow straightforward programmatic messaging.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: All-in-one collaborative workspace combining chat, docs, video conferencing, and base databases by ByteDance.
auth_methods: App Access Token, Tenant Access Token, User Access Token (OAuth2)
access_details: Free plan available; Lark Developer Console allows instant custom bot application creation and token acquisition.
main_blocker: Requires exchanging App ID & Secret for 2-hour Tenant Access Token (`tenant_access_token`).
composio_strategy: Automated token refresher with actions across Lark Messenger, Bitable tables, and Calendar.
verification_notes: Tenant access token handshake must be handled by SDK; highly capable API surface.

name: Pumble
one_liner: Free team communication and business chat app serving as an affordable Slack alternative.
auth_methods: Bot Token, Incoming Webhook URL, OAuth2
access_details: Free plan forever with unlimited message history; custom bots and incoming webhooks created via workspace integrations.
main_blocker: API surface is less extensive than Slack; focused primarily on message sending and channel lookup.
composio_strategy: Bot token toolkit for message posting, channel queries, and alert dispatch.
verification_notes: Very straightforward webhook and bot token setup, zero financial barrier.

name: Discord
one_liner: Community voice, video, and text communication platform widely used by gaming, tech, and developer groups.
access_details: 100% free instant access; create application and bot user in Discord Developer Portal in 30 seconds.
main_blocker: Privileged Gateway Intents (Message Content) must be toggled on developer portal for bots reading text.
composio_strategy: Bot Token + Gateway socket wrapper for listening to mentions and sending rich embeds.
verification_notes: Universal developer adoption; Gateway intents are the only friction point.

name: Telegram
one_liner: Cloud-based encrypted instant messaging and broadcast channel platform with rich bot automation.
access_details: 100% free instant access; message @BotFather on Telegram to generate bot token in 10 seconds.
api_surface: HTTP REST Bot API, MTProto Client API, Long Polling / Webhooks
main_blocker: None; fastest bot provisioning in the entire software industry.
composio_strategy: Bot API toolkit supporting sendMessage, sendPhoto, inline keyboard actions, and webhook reception.
verification_notes: Zero gating, zero credentials delay, simplest token format.

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Global messaging API connecting businesses with over 2 billion WhatsApp users for customer communication.
auth_methods: Bearer Token (System User / User Access Token via Meta Graph)
access_details: Meta Developer account allows self-serve sandbox testing with test numbers; live numbers require Meta Business Verification, official phone number registration, and per-conversation billing.
api_surface: REST (Meta Graph API Cloud API), Webhooks
main_blocker: Meta Business Manager verification, template message approval rules, and 24-hour customer service window.
composio_strategy: Cloud API connector handling approved template dispatches and inbound webhook replies.
verification_notes: Pass 1 noted test sandbox as self-serve; Pass 2 corrected that production deployment is gated behind Meta Business verification and message fees.

name: Aircall
one_liner: Cloud-based business phone system and call center software integrated with CRM and helpdesk tools.
access_details: Requires active paid subscription (Essentials/Professional) or trial request to access company dashboard and generate API keys.
main_blocker: Requires provisioned paid account; telephony carrier compliance for outbound dialling.
composio_strategy: API ID + Token wrapper for logging call notes, fetching recordings, and initiating click-to-call.
verification_notes: Pass 1 assumed free developer sandbox; Pass 2 verified account must be provisioned via sales trial or paid plan.

name: Vonage
one_liner: Communications API platform (formerly Nexmo) for SMS, voice, video, and multi-channel verification.
auth_methods: API Key & Secret, JWT (Application ID + Private Key)
access_details: Free developer account with €2 free credit; instant access to API key and secret in Vonage Dashboard.
main_blocker: Voice and Messages v1 require generating an RSA private key and signing JWTs.
composio_strategy: SDK wrapper handling JWT generation with uploaded private key and API key header injection.
verification_notes: Instant self-serve trial with testing credits; dual auth model (Basic for SMS, JWT for Voice/RTC).

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Digital advertising platform for search, display, YouTube video, and shopping campaigns.
access_details: Test accounts can be accessed with test developer token; production access requires formal Google approval process, Manager Account (MCC), and compliance review.
main_blocker: Mandatory Developer Token vetting: Standard access requires business verification, volume audits, and compliance forms.
composio_strategy: Bring-your-own Developer Token with automated OAuth2 refresh for GAQL query execution and campaign bidding.
verification_notes: CRITICAL CAVEAT: Developer Token approval is notoriously gatekept by Google; test tokens work only on dummy accounts.

name: Meta Ads
one_liner: Advertising platform across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and Audience Network.
access_details: Sandbox development access available immediately; live campaign management requires Meta App Review (`ads_management` permission), Business Verification, and Ad Account binding.
main_blocker: Rigorous Meta App Review, Business Manager corporate verification, and privacy policy compliance check.
composio_strategy: System User Access Token configuration for enterprise ad reporting, campaign creation, and audience syncing.
verification_notes: App Review takes days/weeks; unapproved apps cannot touch real spend or live ad accounts.

name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: B2B professional marketing and sponsored advertising platform targeted by company, title, and industry.
access_details: Requires applying to the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Program; apps must be reviewed and approved by LinkedIn before gaining advertising product permissions.
main_blocker: Marketing Developer Program application gate; independent developers without corporate standing are routinely rejected.
composio_strategy: OAuth2 connector targeting approved enterprise client credentials for analytics and lead gen forms.
verification_notes: Strict developer review gating. Self-serve development is limited to personal profile APIs.

name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: All-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform built specifically for digital agencies and consultants.
auth_methods: OAuth2, Bearer API Key (Private Integration / Location Token)
access_details: Requires active agency subscription ($97-$497/mo) to access developer marketplace and issue API v2 Location keys.
main_blocker: Must have an active agency or sub-account; API v2 requires Location ID parameter for tenant isolation.
composio_strategy: OAuth2 / Location token actions for pipelines, contacts, appointment bookings, and SMS conversations.
verification_notes: API v2 replaced legacy company keys; requires active paid agency subscription.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Email marketing and newsletter platform with contact segmentation and automated drip campaigns.
auth_methods: API Key (passed with suffix datacenter e.g. `us19`), OAuth2
access_details: Free Marketing plan allows instant API Key generation under Account > Extras > API Keys.
main_blocker: API URL requires extracting datacenter prefix from the API key suffix (e.g. `https://{dc}.api.mailchimp.com/3.0/`).
composio_strategy: Auto-detecting datacenter router parsing API key for audience subscriptions and campaign triggers.
verification_notes: Classic API design; datacenter routing is the only minor friction point.

name: Klaviyo
one_liner: E-commerce-focused customer data and marketing platform delivering automated email, SMS, and push notifications.
auth_methods: Private API Key (`pk_...` Bearer / Header), OAuth2
access_details: Free plan includes full API access; generate Private API Keys in Settings > API Keys with granular scopes.
main_blocker: Mandatory `revision` header required on all requests; strict JSON:API payload standards.
composio_strategy: Header-injected Private API Key wrapper handling profiles, segments, event tracking, and metric queries.
verification_notes: Exemplary developer documentation; JSON:API specification rigorously enforced.

name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one sales funnel builder, email marketing, online course host, and affiliate management tool.
access_details: Free plan forever includes full access to Public API keys via Profile > Settings > Public API Keys.
main_blocker: Limited endpoint breadth compared to enterprise marketing automation; covers contacts, tags, courses.
composio_strategy: Simple `x-api-key` header action set for contact creation, tag assignment, and course enrollments.
verification_notes: Very simple and accessible; free account generates API keys without credit card.

name: Pinterest
one_liner: Visual discovery engine and social bookmarking network for shopping inspiration, moodboards, and product pins.
access_details: Trial app access provides sandbox tokens; production access for organic pins and ads requires formal Pinterest App Review approval.
main_blocker: Production App Review required for public/commercial pin creation and ad campaign access.
composio_strategy: OAuth2 provider for Pin creation, board management, and analytics queries.
verification_notes: Pass 1 marked as Ready; Pass 2 corrected: Standard production tier requires business review.

name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Text-based social conversation platform built by Instagram/Meta as a microblogging network.
access_details: Meta Developer portal allows app setup and tester accounts; publishing posts and reading replies for non-test accounts requires Meta App Review (`threads_basic`, `threads_content_publish`).
main_blocker: Meta App Review required for public account publishing; strict 2-step media container publishing flow.
composio_strategy: OAuth2 connector implementing container creation and publish execution for text/image/video threads.
verification_notes: Threads API launched publicly in mid-2024; Pass 1 assumed it was still in closed beta. Now fully buildable!

name: SendGrid
one_liner: Cloud-based transactional email delivery, marketing campaigns, and deliverability infrastructure by Twilio.
access_details: Free plan provides 100 emails/day forever; instant API Key creation with fine-grained access control.
main_blocker: Sender identity verification (domain DKIM/SPF or verified sender email) required before sending live mail.
composio_strategy: API Key action library for mail/send, template rendering, and delivery event monitoring.
verification_notes: Unmatched developer ergonomics; zero friction beyond sender verification.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Global multi-channel commerce platform powering online stores, point of sale, and checkout experiences.
access_details: Free Shopify Partner account lets developers create unlimited development stores with full API capabilities.
api_surface: GraphQL Admin API, REST Admin API, Storefront API, Webhooks
main_blocker: Store subdomain prefix (`{shop}.myshopify.com`) and GraphQL cost limit calculation (1000 points/sec).
composio_strategy: Partner OAuth2 / Custom App token toolkit with high-level actions for products, orders, inventory, and fulfillment.
verification_notes: Shopify Partner program is best-in-class for free development testing.

name: WooCommerce
one_liner: Open-source, highly customizable e-commerce platform built natively on WordPress.
auth_methods: HTTP Basic (Consumer Key & Consumer Secret over HTTPS), OAuth 1.0a
access_details: 100% free open-source software; install on any WordPress site and generate REST API keys under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.
main_blocker: Requires a running WordPress instance with HTTPS enabled.
composio_strategy: Consumer Key & Secret HTTP Basic connector with actions for orders, customers, and product catalogs.
verification_notes: Completely self-serve; open-source nature ensures zero external gate.

name: BigCommerce
one_liner: Open SaaS enterprise e-commerce platform offering headless capabilities and high-volume storefronts.
access_details: 15-day free trial or free BigCommerce Partner account gives instant access to create API Accounts in Advanced Settings > API Accounts.
main_blocker: Store hash (`stores/{store_hash}/v3/`) must be included in endpoint path.
composio_strategy: Store-hash parameterized API token integration covering orders, catalog, customers, and inventory.
verification_notes: Partner account gives free permanent sandboxes for integration testing.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Enterprise-scale cloud commerce solution (formerly Demandware) for global B2C and B2B digital commerce.
auth_methods: OAuth2 (Salesforce Commerce API / Account Manager Client ID & Secret)
access_details: Strictly enterprise contract gated; sandboxes and Account Manager credentials require active enterprise contract or certified Partner program status.
api_surface: REST (Salesforce Commerce API / SCAPI), OCAPI (Open Commerce API)
main_blocker: Enterprise partner contract required; no self-serve public sandboxes without official partner agreement.
composio_strategy: Enterprise Account Manager OAuth2 bridge for enterprise clients managing SCAPI carts and orders.
verification_notes: Pass 1 confused Salesforce CRM Developer Orgs with Commerce Cloud (Demandware), which is strictly enterprise-gated.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
one_liner: Enterprise e-commerce platform offering extreme flexibility, B2B wholesale, and multi-store architectures.
auth_methods: Bearer Token (Admin Token / Integration Token), OAuth 1.0a
access_details: Magento Open Source is 100% free to self-host with full REST/GraphQL API access; Adobe Commerce Cloud is enterprise-licensed.
main_blocker: Self-hosted environment required for open-source; enterprise cloud edition requires contract.
composio_strategy: Bearer token integration provider supporting orders, products, inventory tiers, and invoice generation.
verification_notes: Open-source edition provides complete API parity for testing.

name: Squarespace
one_liner: Design-centric website builder, hosting service, and integrated commerce store platform.
access_details: Commerce APIs require an active Commerce Advanced plan or a free developer trial site created via Squarespace Circle / Developer portal.
main_blocker: Commerce API keys are locked behind high-tier plans (Commerce Advanced) on standard accounts.
composio_strategy: API Key wrapper focusing on inventory management, order fulfillment, and transaction syncing.
verification_notes: Pass 1 missed that Commerce API key generation is disabled on Basic or Core plans.

name: Ecwid
one_liner: Embeddable e-commerce widget enabling online shopping carts on any website or social media page by Lightspeed.
auth_methods: OAuth2, Secret Token (`token` query param / Bearer header)
access_details: Free Ecwid registered developer account provides instant access to sandbox store and API access tokens.
main_blocker: Store ID required in all route URLs (`https://app.ecwid.com/api/v3/{storeId}/`).
composio_strategy: OAuth2 & Secret token provider for store catalog queries, order processing, and customer lookup.
verification_notes: Very friendly developer program with immediate access to test stores.

name: Gumroad
one_liner: Direct-to-consumer digital commerce and creator platform for selling digital downloads, software, and memberships.
access_details: 100% free account creation; generate Personal Access Tokens or register OAuth applications in Settings > Advanced > Applications.
main_blocker: None; straightforward REST endpoints for products, sales, subscribers, and license verification.
composio_strategy: Token-based toolkit for license key verification, product listings, and sales notification webhooks.
verification_notes: Excellent tool for agent monetization and software license checks.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) for sellers and vendors to manage orders, inventory, pricing, and FBA.
auth_methods: LWA (Login with Amazon) OAuth2 + AWS IAM / Signature Version 4 (SigV4)
access_details: Requires an active Amazon Professional Selling Account ($39.99/mo), AWS IAM role configuration, and submission of a Developer Profile subject to strict data security audit.
main_blocker: Brutal double-auth hurdle (AWS SigV4 + LWA OAuth) and strict Amazon Data Protection Policy (DPP) audit gating.
composio_strategy: Enterprise connector pre-configuring SigV4 request signing and LWA token delegation.
verification_notes: One of the most complex auth structures in e-commerce; SigV4 + LWA token + strict security vetting.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: Creator and influencer monetization platform providing embedded checkout SDKs and subscription billing.
access_details: Operates infrastructure under Commas; developer portal (`dev-docs.fanbasis.com`) and checkout SDK (`@fanbasis/checkout-sdk`) require merchant onboarding/account approval.
main_blocker: Merchant account verification for live card transactions; sandbox environment available for testing.
composio_strategy: REST checkout session creation and webhook handler for transaction events.
verification_notes: Pass 1 thought fanbasis had no API. Pass 2 revealed active developer portal (`dev-docs.fanbasis.com`) and npm SDK (`@fanbasis/checkout-sdk`).

name: DataForSEO
one_liner: Comprehensive programmatic data API provider for SEO, SERP rankings, keywords, backlinks, and on-page audits.
access_details: Instant self-serve registration provides $1 free sandbox testing credit; pay-as-you-go thereafter without monthly minimums.
main_blocker: None; asynchronous postback/pingback architecture for long-running SERP crawls requires callback support.
composio_strategy: HTTP Basic wrapper supporting SERP queries, keyword search volume, and domain backlink analysis.
verification_notes: Excellent API for search intelligence agents; instant self-serve trial.

name: SE Ranking
one_liner: All-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform for keyword tracking, competitor analysis, and site audits.
access_details: API access requires an active paid subscription (Pro or Business plans); free trial does not include API key generation.
main_blocker: Paid plan requirement; API units must be purchased on top of base plan for heavy usage.
composio_strategy: Token-authenticated toolkit for keyword rankings, competitor research, and site audit reports.
verification_notes: Pass 1 noted 14-day trial; Pass 2 confirmed trial accounts lack API keys unless upgraded to Pro.

name: Ahrefs
one_liner: Industry-leading SEO toolset and web crawler index for backlink profiling, keyword analysis, and content exploration.
access_details: Strictly paid gate; API access requires an active Enterprise subscription with API units (costing thousands of dollars annually).
main_blocker: Prohibitive pricing gate; no free or self-serve developer tier for independent builders.
composio_strategy: Enterprise BYOC connector executing v3 REST queries for domain ratings, backlinks, and keyword stats.
verification_notes: Ahrefs API v3 is famously locked behind expensive Enterprise plans; major blocker for indie agents.

name: MrScraper
one_liner: Visual web scraper and automated data extraction service converting web pages into structured JSON.
access_details: Free plan includes 30 scrape credits/month; instant API token generated from user profile settings.
